text.p: Morgan Stanley Dean Witter analysts Rafael Bello and Yovanka Bylander raised their rating on Mexico's Grupo Financiero Bancomer SA de CV to strong buy from outperform.
-- They wrote in a report that the upgrade was based on Bancomer's "attractive valuation" compared with Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival, or Banacci.

-- "As in the case of Banacci, we believe Bancomer is a leveraged play on the recovery of the Mexican economy. As such, we believe Mexican banks should outperform the market over the next six-12 months," they wrote.
-- Their price target for Bancomer is US$12.50. Bello and Bylander raised their price target for Banacci to US$3.50 from US$3.
-- "With our ... price targets we are looking at 30 percent upside potential for Banacci and 27 percent upside potential for Bancomer."
